text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, while I was 
cooling down with Hishi Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's Bamboo-chan and Yaeno-chan.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"We've run quite a lot... Shall we head 
back soon?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No—not yet! I'm gonna keep running until 
the sun goes down!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall keep you company to 
the very ends.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...They're still running. Both of them 
are working so hard..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
............ The two of them are far more 
talented than I am, and yet they're 
pushing that hard...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then wouldn't it be really bad if I don't 
work even harder...ed?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? Maybe I could ask to 
join in on their independent training...
choice_data_list: If you want to go, then go ahead.
That'll lead to overwork, so let's not.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes... I've decided to go after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-chan, Yaeno-chaaan! Mind if I run 
with you two~?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle-san. Of course, I don't mind 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Seeing the two of you made me 
feel like I have to do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh! The sunset, riverbank, training 
hard with friends! It's so hype!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let the three of us sprint 
with all our might toward the sunset!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Osu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle worked up a sweat 
doing extra training together with the two 
of them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Overworking... you're right. I did do a 
lot of training today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I think I'll head home and get plenty 
of rest for today.
